claim: Rebates are a scam? : r/menards - Reddit
summary: Yes. Menards rebates are a total scam. They even beat a class action lawsuit, which means they are legally allowed to scam you. Technically it isnt even a "rebate" but a store credit for future purchases - and that ONLY if they dont pretend it got "lost in the mail." You could send it with a tracking number and tske pics of the forms etc for safekeeping to fight them on each rebate you send in ...
